'''Tunms''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on the Imperial [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Reclamation Officer Tunms first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the Pre-Order Crystal Vendor aboard Vaiken Spacedock; players who pre-ordered the game can acquire exclusive crystals from him.<ref name="TOR" />
